src='''def transform(grid):
    """Recolor complete foreground-color lines and full separator rows."""
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    foreground = next((v for v in set(grid[0]) if v != 0 and all(x == v for x in grid[0])), None)
    # Separators are rows entirely filled with the non-background marker.
    separators = [i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    if not separators:
        return out
    marker = grid[separators[0]][0]
    for r in separators:
        out[r] = [2] * len(grid[r])
    # Within each band, recolor marker cells in columns filled by marker throughout that band.
    starts = [0] + [r + 1 for r in separators]
    ends = separators + [len(grid)]
    for start, end in zip(starts, ends):
        if start >= end:
            continue
        for c in range(len(grid[0])):
            if all(grid[r][c] == marker for r in range(start, end)):
                for r in range(start, end):
                    out[r][c] = 2
    return out
'''
